newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss franc bonds ended a quiet day little changed on Tuesday as market participants said most professionals seemed content to maintain their positions.
"Things look kind of locked, no buying, no selling," one trader said.
The cash market followed the March CONF higher which rose 18 basis points to 120.78 percent on a modest 661 contracts.
Federal government bonds saw slight demand. Domestic bonds in general saw light interest in long maturities.
